description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A very long oval open basket has a washable blank fabric food liner folded over its rim. Side: Its shallow trough has rounded ends and a rigid flat bottom. Rear: The rear rim shows continuous lashings beneath the removable liner. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
